en: You're right. It's time I stopped running away from reality.
Um... Akiyama-san?

I know I put you through a lot of trouble, but could you
please forget about my loan?

Sure, that's fine. On one condition⑬don't do anything
half-heartedly anymore. Deal? I'll be rooting for you.
Thank you for everything.
Heh, I didn't do anything worth thanks.

Well, that's that! And I'll be damned, I really didn't do
anything this time. Well, except maybe blow through more
money.

At this rate, it's going to be quite a while before the
Sotenbori branch gets back on track...
You got 3,200 experience points.
Hey, welcome back.
I did it! I had the highest sales today!
Sounds like it. I got a call from the club's manager.
What do you think? Did I change your opinion of me?
Heh, I guess you have.
Oh! There you are! You kept me waiting long enough.
Sorry, sorry. I had to step out for a quick errand.
I collected your loan like you wanted.
Good job.

*pant* *pant* It's finally over. My knees, my back... All
my joints feel like they're made of rubber.

Welcome back... You look a little winded, there. Are you
going to be all right?

You said it was a job using my body, but you never said
anything about working at a construction site!

Oh, I didn't? Well, anyhow, cheer up. You succeeded. You
passed that test.
Okay then, what should I have you do next?
Next!? I'm not done yet?
If you pass my tests, I'll loan you the money.
...Oh, all right. Fine. I'll do whatever you want!
Heh. I admire your commitment.
(What should I assign her?)

Let's have you work at a cabaret club⑬see if you have
what it takes to become the number one earner.
Huh? Me, a hostess?

Yup. I'll hook you up with a friend's club. You'll work
there.

But this is so out of the blue. I have a busy career, too,
you know.

You only have to work one day. If you're the highest earner
that day, you pass. If not, you fail.
Oh. Just one day? That's too easy.

I'm a pinup idol, remember? A celebrity! If I just so much
as mention it on my blog, my fans will come stampeding.
Does today work?
Sure! If you want, I can go right now!

Perfect. I'll get in touch with the club, so off you go. The
place is called Magamoto.
O-kay! 300 million, here I come!
(Well, well. This should be interesting...)
Welcome back. That was quick.

What kind of place did you send me to!? There's no way I
could make number one there!

Oh? I thought you said it would be easy for a celebrity to
become the top girl.

Not when all the girls working at that club are celebrities!
They're all pros like me!
They sure are. That's the club's big draw.

There were even younger girls from my agency! If I could
become top earner there, I wouldn't need to go independent!
So you gave up without even trying?
I guess you fail, then. That's too bad.

Wait! Wait a second! I didn't say anything about giving
up!
But you said you can't win, isn't that right?

That's not true! I'll beat the girls from my agency for
sure. Just you watch!

(Well. I thought she was all talk, but she might have more
drive than I expected.)

(Mamagoto Club is in East Shofukucho. I should swing by and
see how she's holding up.)

I'll have you collect on a loan. Just stop by and get the
money for me.
Oh, an errand? Sure, no problem.

The client is Murata Trading in the Shofuku Sotenbori
Building. Show them these papers, and they'll get the picture.
Got it! I'll leave right now!
300 million, here I come!

(Success takes risk, huh? Let's see if she really means
that. Better check on her at Shofuku Sotenbori Building.)
I want you to put that body of yours to work.

It might be tough for a pin-up idol, but sometimes dreams
don't come true unless you give it everything you have, you
know?

You can always say no. But that, of course, means you fail
the test.

If it were my agency asking this of me, I would never
accept. But since it's of my own free will... I can do it.
I will do it.
Heh, if you say so...
Where do you want me to go?

Head on over to Sotenbori Street. I'll let them know you're
coming, so they'll approach you when you get there.

Okay. It's for 300 million yen. I'm going to give it
everything I've got!
(Okay... Let's see just how well little miss innocent fares.)
Okay, on to the next one.
Huh? I'm not done?

Of course not. Nobody said anything about that being the
only test.

300 million is a lot of money. I can't hand that over for
doing just one simple task.
Okay. I'll do it. What do you want me to do next?
Let's see...

en: (What should I have her do next?)
First, may I have your name, please?
Nanako Kodama.

Okay, Kodama-san. You mentioned you were seeking a loan. How
much were you hoping to get?
300 million?
300 million!?
Yes. I heard that you'll lend any amount.
Sheesh, word on the street's really getting out of hand...
You mean you won't lend me the money?

I'm not sure yet... Why exactly would you need that kind of
money?
You see, I'm actually a pin-up idol.
Heh... Well, you certainly look like one.
(Nice boobs, too.)

Akiyama-san, I heard about you from an older girl. She said
you took care of her.
Did she now?
And? What does a pin-up idol want from me?

It's my agency. They stopped treating me with the kind of
respect I deserve.

They said they're changing my promotion approach and
suddenly demanded that I change my public persona.

They call you an idol, but that's just a title. I imagine
even an idol will have to change to meet the market's needs
and wants.

My fans aren't like that! They know Nanako Kodama is the
real deal. What you see is what you get!
If I were to suddenly change, I would be betraying my fans!

I can understand that, but your agency must think you can
attract even more fans by doing so.

It's not about numbers! I most certainly can't and won't
betray the people who have supported me so far.

Long story short, I decided I would be better off promoting
myself.
You're looking to go independent?

Yes! If I want to stay me, I have to set up my own agency
and represent myself!

I see. In other words, you're seeking a loan to kick-start
your own agency. That about sum it up?
Exactly!
Do you have any seed money?
None!
Business plan?
Nope!
ctx: diálogo uid00490147 + frase de acompañante/calle STID_ST_NAGOYA

en: Really...
So, why 300 million yen?

Since you're in the entertainment business, you should know
that, behind the glitz and glamor, money's oftentimes
extremely tight.

Not even top stars get promoted with that massive a budget
these days.

You're looking at it backwards. Spend 300 million yen, and
you can make a star out of just about anyone.

It's just like Korean dramas and music. They only broke out
in Japan after being promoted like crazy. This is no
different.
You may have a point there.

I don't think you should go cheap on promotion just because
the economy is bad. Success takes risks!

I want to prove my agency wrong and succeed as Nanako
Kodama⑬just as I am, no faking it. For that, I need 300
million yen!

Okay then, instead of a loan assessment, I'll have you take
some tests. If you can pass them, the 300 million is yours.
Tests?
Indeed. Success takes risks, isn't that what you said?

I get it. Okay, I'll do it! If it means making my dream come
true, I'll do anything you ask!
I like your attitude.
So, what would you have me do?
(What should her assignment be?)

I'm a pin-up idol, remember? A celebrity! If I just so much
as mention it on my blog, my fans will come stampeding.

Perfect. I'll get in touch with the club, so off you go. The
place is called Mamagoto.
Heh, all right.
*huff* *pant* ...That was close.
Er, um...
How was it? It made you warm like it was supposed to, didn't it?
You want me to kill ya?
Uh, never mind!
So, where's this ultimate cold weather gear?
Hehe... Right here in my hand!
That? Looks like it's just a pocket warmer.
You might think that, yes. However! This is no ordinary pocket warmer. It's the ultimate pocket warmer!
Yes. It produces several thousand times the heat of a regular one. Truly, it is the king of pocket warmers!
With one of these, Tsukimino will feel like a tropical paradise! Heck, so would Antarctica! So would the moon!
...The moon ain't happenin'. And did ya say it's thousands of times hotter n' a regular one? Wouldn't that start a fire?
It'll probably be fine. I adjusted some things so it shouldn't ignite.
You ain't doin' too good a job of sellin' me on safety. Gettin' kinda scared here.
Oh, please, a big man like you? Very well. I will demonstrate first and prove that it's perfectly safe.
After that, you can test it. That sound okay?
Here we go. First, I activate the unit.
Yowwwww!
Aaaugh! Did I screw something up?
Shoulda seen this comin'... Hey! Do somethin' before the whole place burns down!
There's a fire extinguisher over there! Please, put it out!
(Better put this out, first. Then I'll deal with Ideno the Idiot.)

Hello, I'm here to collect on your loan. Now, if you
wouldn't mind paying up!
Huh? And who're you?

Akiyama-san from Sky Finance sent me. He said to show you
these.
Sky Finance?
Eh!
Hmph. This ain't what we agreed on. I ain't payin' shit!

I borrowed on the promise of no interest. Now he's tellin'
me he wants immediate repayment with interest? Guy can go
fuck himself.

But that has nothing to do with me! Is that what those
papers say?

Ya heard me⑬I ain't payin'. Not a single yen! Now get outta
my office.

I'm sorry, but I can't do that! I have to collect that loan
from you!

You got somethin' in your ears, lady!? I said I ain't
payin', and I damn well meant it! Hit the road!
...No! I'm not leaving!

I'm sick and tired of doing what other people want! I want
to be a star on my own terms!

Besides, if you hurt me, you're going to be in big trouble.
Akiyama-san knows I came here. If anything were to happen to
me, he'd go straight to the police.
All right, you win. I'll pay your money. Hold on.
Here. Now scram.
Thank you very much! Bye!
Man, what a piece of work...
Oh, hey. You saw all that?

So you're really lettin' me off the hook for that loan you
gave me? I tried scarin' that girlie like ya told me to.
Didn't actually hafta succeed, though, right?

Right. That was perfect. What was in that bundle you handed
her?
A stack of losing lottery tickets.
Ha, got it. Nice ad-lib.

That little babe turned around and threatened me. She's
sharper and gutsier than she lets on.
(Better get back to the office.)

I consulted a lawyer. He got me off the hook with those
loan sharks.

From now on, I'm your customer. Thank you so much for taking
me on.

Happy to help. Of course, you still have a mountain of debt.
You'll have to work it off.

Um... Would you please accept this? I know it may seem odd
coming from a borrower, but...
You got <Color:8>Angler's Hook<Color:Default>.
Heh, sure. Thanks.
I have to get to work. See you around!
(He'll be okay... I think.)
Okay! It's now or never! Hopefully they won't kill me...

...No! I'm going to live! I'm going to get out of this
and get my life together! Here I go! Aaaaahhhhh!
(Well... I'm eager to see how this plays out.)
(It's been a while. I suppose I should check in on him.)
Uh, hey, pal. What are you doing?
Don't try to stop me! I have to kill myself!

Oh. Well, you're probably not going to die if you jump from
there. Not unless you can't swim.
You idiot, stay out of this!
It was just startin' to get good, too.
Well, that sucked. Let's go.
Huh? I'm the bad guy here?
...Sorry to drag you into this.

No kidding. I feel like a real ass trying to play the good
guy.

So, why kill yourself? I'm already involved⑬I may as well
hear you out.

I was a little short on money, so I went to a loan shark.
And long story short, I now owe more than I can ever hope to
repay.

You should have consulted a lawyer right away. They would
have shut down any threats in no time flat.

Well, the loan sharks seem to know that. They said they'd
kill me if I went to a lawyer. Plus, they're watching my
every move, so I couldn't call one even if I wanted to...

So you settled on killing yourself? Didn't really think that
through, did you?

It's always this way with me. I fail at everything I do.
This debt isn't even mine⑬I was forced into being a
guarantor.

And now, it turns out I can't even kill myself properly. I
don't know what to do anymore...
Hm. Depressing.

But you're in luck for a change. After all, it was none
other than me who stopped you from jumping.

I haven't introduced myself. I'm Akiyama. I run a
moneylending business by the name of Sky Finance.
